title: HAR-ICL: code and results for "Discrete Sensor Tokens for In-Context Recognition of Unseen Human Activities"
description: Code, configuration files, per-seed result files and SLURM logs accompanying the manuscript "Discrete Sensor Tokens for In-Context Recognition of Unseen Human Activities". A class-discriminative VQ-VAE converts IMU windows into discrete tokens that a frozen GPT-2 with LoRA adapters reads in context to recognize unseen human activities; a matched continuous control isolates the effect of discreteness.
